title: The Unbroken Line: First Lesson

texts.details:
You can throw fire. So can a torch. Sit down. You will not tire; none of us do.

Two things I want from you, and they are one lesson. First: conjure me water. Two flasks, made by you, from nothing. I cannot taste it any longer, but I shall know whether it is real.

Second. Before I died I made a familiar, and when I woke in the crypt I had forgotten it. It has been drifting in the fields outside the town ever since. The Deathguards have named it Cain's Regret, which I do not find amusing. Go and take it apart, $N.
texts.objectives: Conjure 2 Conjured Water for your teacher and unmake Cain's Regret, which drifts in the fields outside Brill. Then return.
texts.progress: Water first. Anyone can destroy. We are proof of that.
texts.completion:
Real water. And my Regret is unmade? Then you have done both halves of what a mage does. You have made a thing from nothing, and you have cleaned up after one.

Remember the second half. Every spell leaves something behind. Mine, yours, those of mages dead three thousand years. This land is thick with what our kind forgot to unmake.

And know this, $N. Someone taught me, in Dalaran, when I breathed. Someone taught him. So back and back, unbroken, to the first. Death did not cut you out of that line. Choose one of these. When you have twenty seasons, go to the Sepulcher in Silverpine and find Dalar Dawnweaver. He will show you where it leads.

idea: The Unbroken Line, level 10 (Horde): conjure water and unmake a loose conjuration. Invented: Cain's Regret.
